cat docs/policies/cache-eviction.md

I didn't run `muninn show 8` or `muninn why` to check the record. I relied on the catalog listing #8 as current. The file was written with the Write tool because my first attempt with a shell command failed with a parser error.

The Muninn heartbeat also reported 20 hooks that started and never finished. That doesn't affect this file, but `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl` is the place to look.
